facts.business: Midwest Energy Limited (formerly Midwest Gold Limited) is engaged in energy-related operations following the amalgamation of Midwest Energy Private Limited, with consolidated subsidiaries involved in plasma systems and international operations.

auditor.name: M/S. MAJETI & CO.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis on unpaid subscribed capital in subsidiary M & M Plasma Systems Private Limited and non-filing of Form INC-20A; reliance on other auditors for 3 subsidiaries and 4 step-down subsidiaries; one step-down subsidiary outside India unaudited but not material.

key_risks: Subsidiary M & M Plasma Systems Private Limited has unpaid subscribed capital of Rs. 7.50 lakhs and has not filed Form INC-20A for commencement of business
Consolidated operations reported a loss before tax of Rs. 1,400.69 lakhs in FY 2025-26
Reliance on unaudited financial statements of one step-down subsidiary outside India
Going concern assessment dependent on management's evaluation of financial resources and projected commercial operations
facts.related_party_note: Preferential allotments made to promoters, promoter group, and non-promoter investors during FY 2025-26 at issue prices of Rs. 1,500 and Rs. 2,000 per share.
